name: Sent back
prompt: A server brings a plate back to the pass. Over medium, the customer says, and these eggs are over hard.

outcome.told: You crack two more eggs. The new plate goes out four minutes later.

choices.text: Tell the server the eggs are right

outcome.told: The server takes it back out. The customer eats it.

failure.told: The customer asks for the owner. The owner remakes the plate herself and looks at you while she does it.
